details.en:
Since 2.2.0, both `run_acl(x)` and `run_alscl(x)` accept a complete named input list. For `YTF_example`, they read the three tables and `x$fit_args`, then the matching `x$fit_config$acl` or `x$fit_config$alscl`. Explicit call arguments have highest priority, for example `run_acl(x, M = 0.25, nstarts = 4, ncores = 2)`. List-valued overrides (`parameters`, `map`, `control`) replace the whole stored list, and explicit `NULL` is retained. The simulation settings in `x$parameters` and the generating `x$truth` are not fitting arguments.

For your own data, `x` can instead be a flat named list containing `data.CatL`, `data.wgt`, `data.mat`, `rec.age`, `nage`, `M`, `sel_L50`, `sel_L95` and any optional fitting arguments. A structured bundle may omit `fit_config` to use the model defaults; if it includes `fit_config`, that list must contain the selected model. Duplicate, unnamed, unknown or missing required arguments produce an error before fitting. All calls use the existing fitting core and `alscl_speed()` settings; inspect `fit$sd_info` to see the actual standard-error method. `ncores` controls independent optimization starts, while `sd_cores` in `alscl_speed()` controls standard errors.

Natural and fishing mortality are instantaneous rates per model step; growth k is annual. Fixing survey catchability anchors the abundance scale. Zeros are excluded with `zero_action="missing"`; decide whether that is appropriate for your observations. `nstarts` controls the total starts and `ncores` limits simultaneous socket workers; by default nstarts = ncores for compatibility. `train_times` controls successive optimizer passes. Inspect `start_diagnostics` for worker PIDs, timing and convergence. A zero convergence code alone does not establish reliable inference. Keep the DLL loaded to evaluate `obj` in the same R session.

Starting values do not fix parameters. A whole `map = NULL` or `list()` applies model defaults: ACL fixes `log_std_log_F`, `logit_log_F_y`, `logit_log_F_a`, `t0`; ALSCL fixes `log_sigma_log_F`, `log_t0`. Pass named NULL entries directly to release default fixes; single-bracket assignment preserves them. See the own-data case study for the complete parameter checklist and working example.

## Optimization refinement and F shared across groups

`run_acl(x)` and `run_alscl(x)` now finish the selected fit with up to five safeguarded Newton steps (`polish = TRUE`). Each step requires a positive-definite numerical Hessian, parameters strictly inside their bounds, a smaller maximum absolute gradient, and an objective increase no greater than `1e-8` for floating-point roundoff. Refinement stops if a condition fails; it cannot repair insufficient information or an inappropriate model. Set `polish = FALSE` to skip it. This can change estimates at numerical precision, so 2.2.2 does not promise bitwise equality with older fits.

Repeated optimizer passes retain their raw parameters, objective, code and message in `fit$optimizer_history`. An unchanged failed restart no longer overwrites an earlier successful pass. `fit$raw_opt` records the selected result before refinement; `fit$refinement` records accepted steps and before/after gradients. `convergence_code` remains the selected raw optimizer code, not an invented success code after refinement. Multistart selection still uses the lowest finite objective before refinement; `starts` and `start_diagnostics` describe those unrefined starts.

`fit$diagnostics` adds a separate numerical screen: maximum gradient below `1e-3`, positive-definite Hessian and covariance, no optimizer boundary and no natural-scale boundary. Free correlations within `1e-4` of 0 or 1 and free process/observation SDs at or below `1e-4` are flagged. These are screening thresholds, not statistical tests. `high_correlations` lists parameter pairs with absolute correlation at least 0.95; this warrants investigation but does not alone prove non-identifiability. The covariance condition number depends on parameter scaling. `diagnose_model()` prints the raw optimizer status and numerical screen separately; inspect residuals, alternative starts, profiles and sensitivity as well.

`F_structure="group_year"` estimates an age-by-time (ACL) or length-by-time (ALSCL) F process. `F_structure="year"` shares one F across all groups within each model time step, including one F per quarter for quarterly data. The unused group-correlation parameter is inactive in the shared structure.

Starting in 2.2.3, both fitting functions check the time grid directly: consecutive numeric column labels must differ by `growth_step`. For annual data, `2000, 2001, 2003` is rejected because 2002 is absent. Keep 2002 as an all-`NA` survey column, and provide complete weight and maturity columns for that period. Quarterly labels such as `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` require `growth_step = 0.25`. The model does not interpolate missing periods or reinterpret irregular intervals.

### Package libraries for parallel workers

Multistart fits, retrospective peels and simulation batches initialize socket workers with the parent session's library paths before loading ALSCL. This also applies when a newer installation is selected with `.libPaths()`. All workers must load the same ALSCL installation as the parent. Keep `nstarts` fixed when comparing worker counts; standard-error parallelism continues to use `alscl_speed()`.

### Using the fitted TMB object

After standard-error calculation, the returned live TMB objective is restored to the final fitted parameters. In the fitting R session, `fit$obj$report()` therefore describes the same fitted state as `fit$report`, including sequential standard errors and a fallback from parallel calculation. This does not change the saved estimates or standard errors. Serialized fits still require refitting before using a live TMB objective.

使用自己的数据时，`x` 也可以是扁平命名列表，包含 `data.CatL`、`data.wgt`、`data.mat`、`rec.age`、`nage`、`M`、`sel_L50`、`sel_L95` 以及可选拟合参数。结构化输入可省略 `fit_config`，使用模型默认设置；若包含 `fit_config`，则必须包含所选模型的配置。重名、未命名、未知参数或缺少必需参数都会在拟合前报错。所有写法共用原有拟合核心和 `alscl_speed()` 设置；`fit$sd_info` 记录实际使用的标准误计算方式。`ncores` 控制独立优化起点的并行数，`alscl_speed()` 的 `sd_cores` 控制标准误计算。

自然死亡率和捕捞死亡率是每个模型时间步的瞬时率，生长 k 以年为单位。固定调查可捕性决定丰度尺度。`zero_action="missing"` 会排除零值，使用前应判断是否符合观测含义。`nstarts` 控制总起点数，`ncores` 限制同时工作的 socket 进程数；默认 nstarts = ncores 以兼容旧用法。`train_times` 控制每个起点的连续优化次数。`start_diagnostics` 记录进程 PID、耗时及收敛信息。优化码为零并不单独证明统计推断可靠。`obj` 依赖当前 R 会话内保持加载的动态库。

提供初值不等于固定参数。整个 `map = NULL` 或 `list()` 使用模型默认规则：ACL 固定 `log_std_log_F`、`logit_log_F_y`、`logit_log_F_a`、`t0`；ALSCL 固定 `log_sigma_log_F`、`log_t0`。直接传入具名 NULL 项可解除默认固定，用单方括号赋值保留它。正式数据案例列有完整参数分类和可执行示例。

## 优化收尾与每时间步跨组共用 F

`run_acl(x)` 和 `run_alscl(x)` 默认对选中的拟合执行最多五步受保护的 Newton 收尾（`polish = TRUE`）。每步要求数值 Hessian 正定、参数严格位于上下界内、最大绝对梯度下降，且目标函数增加不超过 `1e-8` 的浮点舍入容差。不满足条件就停止；收尾不能补足资料信息，也不能修复不合适的模型。`polish = FALSE` 可跳过收尾。这可能改变数值精度层面的估计，因此 2.2.2 不承诺与旧版拟合逐位一致。

每轮优化的原始参数、目标函数、代码和信息保存在 `fit$optimizer_history`。后续一轮在同一点误报失败时，不再覆盖前一轮成功状态。`fit$raw_opt` 保存收尾前选中的结果；`fit$refinement` 记录接受的步骤及前后梯度。`convergence_code` 始终表示所选优化轮次的原始代码，不会因收尾而强行改为成功。多起点仍按收尾前最低有限目标函数选取；`starts` 和 `start_diagnostics` 记录收尾前各起点的结果。

`fit$diagnostics` 增加独立的数值筛查：最大梯度小于 `1e-3`、Hessian 与协方差正定、不触及优化器边界或自然尺度边界。自由相关系数距离 0 或 1 不超过 `1e-4`，以及自由过程／观测标准差不超过 `1e-4`，都会标记。这些是筛查阈值，不是统计检验。`high_correlations` 列出绝对相关系数至少 0.95 的参数对，需进一步审查，但不能单凭高相关就断言不可识别。协方差条件数取决于参数尺度。`diagnose_model()` 分别显示原始优化代码和数值筛查结果；仍需检查残差、多起点、似然剖面和敏感性。

`F_structure="group_year"` 使用年龄×时间（ACL）或体长×时间（ALSCL）的 F 过程。`F_structure="year"` 在每个模型时间步内跨组共用一个 F，季度数据即每季度一个 F；共用结构中不使用的组别相关参数处于 inactive 状态。

从 2.2.3 起，两个核心拟合函数直接检查时间网格：相邻数值表头之差必须等于 `growth_step`。年度数据 `2000, 2001, 2003` 会因缺少 2002 而报错；应保留 2002 列，调查值填 `NA`，并提供该期完整的重量和成熟数据。季度表头如 `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` 必须设置 `growth_step = 0.25`。模型不会自动插补缺失时间步，也不会把不规则间隔重新解释为等间隔。

### 并行工作进程的安装库

多起点拟合、回溯和模拟批次的 socket 进程先接收主会话的库路径，再加载 ALSCL；通过 `.libPaths()` 选择新安装版本时也适用。所有工作进程必须加载与主进程相同的 ALSCL 安装。比较核数时保持 `nstarts` 相同，标准误并行继续由 `alscl_speed()` 控制。

### 使用拟合后的 TMB 对象

标准误计算结束后，返回的可执行 TMB 对象会恢复到最终拟合参数。在拟合所在的 R 会话中，`fit$obj$report()` 与 `fit$report` 因此描述同一个拟合状态，包括顺序计算及并行失败后的回退。已保存的估计值和标准误不因此改变。序列化保存的结果仍需重新拟合后才能使用可执行 TMB 对象。

`fit$diagnostics` 增加独立的数值筛查：最大梯度小于 `1e-3`、Hessian 与协方差正定、不触及优化器边界或自然尺度边界。自由相关系数距离 0 或 1 不超过 `1e-4`，以及自由过程／观测标准差不超过 `1e-4`，都会标记。这些是筛查阈值，不是统计检验。`high_correlations` 列出绝对相关系数至少 0.95 的参数对，需进一步审查，但不能单凭高相关就断言不可识别。协方差条件数取决于参数尺度。`diagnose_model()` 分别显示原始优化代码和数值筛查结果；仍需检查残差、多起点、似然剖面和敏感性。

`F_structure="group_year"` 使用年龄×时间（ACL）或体长×时间（ALSCL）的 F 过程。`F_structure="year"` 在每个模型时间步内跨组共用一个 F，季度数据即每季度一个 F；共用结构中不使用的组别相关参数处于 inactive 状态。

从 2.2.3 起，两个核心拟合函数直接检查时间网格：相邻数值表头之差必须等于 `growth_step`。年度数据 `2000, 2001, 2003` 会因缺少 2002 而报错；应保留 2002 列，调查值填 `NA`，并提供该期完整的重量和成熟数据。季度表头如 `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` 必须设置 `growth_step = 0.25`。模型不会自动插补缺失时间步，也不会把不规则间隔重新解释为等间隔。

### 并行工作进程的安装库

多起点拟合、回溯和模拟批次的 socket 进程先接收主会话的库路径，再加载 ALSCL；通过 `.libPaths()` 选择新安装版本时也适用。所有工作进程必须加载与主进程相同的 ALSCL 安装。比较核数时保持 `nstarts` 相同，标准误并行继续由 `alscl_speed()` 控制。

模型首尾体长组吸收分布尾部。`len_border` 只包含内部边界，`len_mid` 是每组递增的中心值。ALSCL 可以省略 `len_lower` 和 `len_upper`，由内部边界生成；若显式提供，必须分别为 `c(-Inf, len_border)` 和 `c(len_border, Inf)`。显式有限外端点会被拒绝，不会实现有限截断的体长分布。`0-20` 等有限区间标签仍可使用，但遵循原有首尾组吸收尾部的约定。

### 使用拟合后的 TMB 对象

标准误计算结束后，返回的可执行 TMB 对象会恢复到最终拟合参数。在拟合所在的 R 会话中，`fit$obj$report()` 与 `fit$report` 因此描述同一个拟合状态，包括顺序计算及并行失败后的回退。已保存的估计值和标准误不因此改变。序列化保存的结果仍需重新拟合后才能使用可执行 TMB 对象。

description.en: Set how fits compute standard errors and which automatic-differentiation library TMB uses. Parallel standard errors match sequential calculations at the same fitted parameters; 2.2.2 refinement can change the optimum.
description.zh: 设置拟合时计算标准误的方式以及 TMB 使用的自动微分库。相同拟合参数处的并行标准误与顺序计算一致；2.2.2 的收尾可能改变最优点。

details.en:
`sd_cores` computes standard errors on several cores; the results are identical to the sequential calculation. On macOS and Linux outside GUI front-ends, forked processes compute the fixed-effect Hessian and the delta method. On Windows, in GUI front-ends such as RStudio and with Apple's Accelerate BLAS, socket workers compute the delta method when it would take more than about 3 seconds, and the Hessian is computed in the main process. Fits that already run on parallel workers, as in `retro_model()` and `sim_acl()`, use one core each. `framework = "TMBad"` speeds up each evaluation of the Laplace approximation, but results differ slightly from CppAD. Use `alscl_speed_info()` to see what the settings mean on your computer; docs/SPEED_GUIDE.md explains every setting.

Installed socket workers load the same package installation as the parent. During `pkgload::load_all()` or `testthat::test_local()`, workers instead load the same source checkout with pkgload. Install the optional development dependency pkgload for this workflow. CI exercises both source-mode parallel tests and the complete installed-package checks.

### Changes in 2.2.9

The checked TMB versions are 1.9.21 and 1.9.25. TMB 1.9.25 passed the strict, no-fallback parallel-equivalence tests for both models and both AD frameworks in the existing Windows, macOS and Linux checks; Windows uses socket workers and skips Unix-fork tests. Other TMB versions retain the sequential safety fallback. This extends eligibility for acceleration, without promising a speed-up for small fits; inspect `fit$sd_info` for the actual method.

description.zh: 合并 ACL 默认参数映射与自定义的固定或释放设置。

value.zh: 合并 ACL 默认规则与用户设置后的具名 TMB 映射列表。factor(NA) 固定参数；具名 NULL 项解除该项默认固定。

Use model-specific names when specifying an ALSCL map. The returned list drops NULL entries. Do not feed it back into `run_acl()` to release a default fix, because the fitter will add the absent default again. Use `run_acl(x, map = list(t0 = NULL))` directly instead. A whole NULL/empty map retains model defaults.
details.zh: `factor(NA)` 将参数固定在所给初值。命名项 `NULL` 可释放默认固定的参数，未指定的默认映射仍保留。本辅助函数使用 ACL 默认值；ALSCL 映射必须使用该模型的参数名称。 返回列表会移除 NULL 项；不要用其返回值再次传给 `run_acl()` 来解除默认固定，因为拟合函数会重新补入缺失默认项。应直接用 `run_acl(x, map = list(t0 = NULL))`。整个 NULL 或空 map 仍使用模型默认规则。

description.en: Evaluate the von Bertalanffy mean length-at-age curve.
description.zh: 计算 von Bertalanffy 平均体长—年龄曲线。

value.en: A numeric vector of mean lengths, corresponding to `age`.
value.zh: 与 `age` 对应的平均体长数值向量。

details.en: Computes `Linf * (1 - exp(-k * (age - t0)))`. Use years for age and t0 and inverse years for k. The result describes mean growth, without individual variation or parameter uncertainty.
details.zh: 计算 `Linf * (1 - exp(-k * (age - t0)))`。age 与 t0 使用年，k 使用每年。结果表示平均生长，不含个体差异或参数估计不确定性。

description.en: Evaluate a logistic curve defined by lengths at 50% and 95%.
description.zh: 根据 50% 与 95% 对应体长计算 logistic 曲线。

value.en: A numeric vector of proportions at the supplied lengths.
value.zh: 所给体长对应的比例数值向量。

details.en:
For increasing maturity curves use `L95 > L50`; descending selectivity permits `L95 < L50`. Equality is invalid. Used for maturity and, in the simulator, catchability/selectivity curves. The same equation does not make these biological concepts interchangeable.

### Stable simulation boundaries in 2.2.5

`mat_func()` uses a stable logistic calculation: a steep increasing curve approaches one without overflowing. `L50` and `L95` must be distinct finite scalars; a descending curve (`L95 < L50`) remains available for dome selectivity. Length values and derived biological arrays must be finite. Simulated natural and fishing mortality must be nonnegative. With both `M = 0` and `F_mean = 0`, fishery catch numbers and biomass are zero, rather than undefined; abundance and recruitment still follow the chosen operating model.

```r
stopifnot(all(is.finite(mat_func(20, 20.1, c(20, 30, 50)))))
pa0 <- initialize_params(species = "flatfish", nyear = 4, burn_in = 2,
                         M = 0, F_mean = 0)
sm0 <- sim_data(sim_cal(pa0), pa0, iter_range = 4,
                output_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "alscl-zero-mortality"))
stopifnot(all(sm0$CN == 0), all(sm0$CB == 0))
```
details.zh:
上升成熟曲线使用 `L95 > L50`；下降选择性允许 `L95 < L50`，两者不能相等。函数可用于成熟比例，模拟器也用其构造可捕性或选择性曲线。数学表达式相同，不代表这些生物学概念相同。

### 2.2.5 的模拟数值边界

`mat_func()` 使用稳定的 logistic 计算，陡峭上升曲线接近 1 时不会溢出。`L50` 与 `L95` 必须是不同的有限标量；仍允许下降曲线（`L95 < L50`），用于穹顶选择性。体长及派生生物矩阵必须有限，模拟的自然与捕捞死亡率必须非负。当 `M = 0` 且 `F_mean = 0` 时，渔获尾数和生物量为零，不再返回未定义数值；丰度和补充量仍按选定模拟模型演变。

```r
stopifnot(all(is.finite(mat_func(20, 20.1, c(20, 30, 50)))))
pa0 <- initialize_params(species = "flatfish", nyear = 4, burn_in = 2,
                         M = 0, F_mean = 0)
sm0 <- sim_data(sim_cal(pa0), pa0, iter_range = 4,
                output_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "alscl-zero-mortality"))
stopifnot(all(sm0$CN == 0), all(sm0$CB == 0))
```

description.en: Build biological and process settings for a simulation operating model.
description.zh: 创建模拟操作模型的生物参数和过程设置。

value.en: A named parameter list with species, age/time/length grids, growth, mortality, recruitment, observation and process settings.
value.zh: 包含物种、年龄/时间/体长网格、生长、死亡率、补充、观测和过程设置的命名参数列表。

details.en:
Species presets select the operating-model structure: flatfish and krill use age_based; tuna uses length_based. Inspect the returned model_type, then call sim_cal() and sim_data(). These simulation labels differ from the estimator choices acl and alscl. The simulator and estimator recruitment processes differ.

Since 2.2.4, `mean_F` in the quick annual simulator is the arithmetic mean of the generated F trajectory; `mean_F = 0` generates zero F. The corrected trajectory changes newly simulated observations even with an old seed. Previously bundled datasets and figures retain their original generating truth.

For the full simulator, `nyear` and `burn_in` are durations in years and must each contain a whole number of `growth_step` intervals. Thus a half-year burn-in is valid with quarterly steps, but not annual steps. Returned `sm$nyear` counts retained steps. `first.year` labels the first retained observation, and `sm$years` records the complete retained calendar. `simulation_to_tables()` and `sim_acl()` preserve this calendar; old files lacking year metadata still have a documented 2000-based fallback. A single retained period stays a matrix, although fitting requires at least two periods.

`sim_acl()` resolves path and parameter variables before sending tasks to socket workers, so ordinary console/script calls work with multiple cores. Retain failed replicates and inspect each fit's diagnostics; successful worker execution alone does not establish a usable assessment.

### Changes in 2.2.9

Simulation length midpoints must lie within their corresponding bins, using the same containment rules as fitting. The first and last bins absorb the tails. Invalid bin geometry is rejected during parameter preparation and rechecked before biological calculations or simulation, including manually modified inputs, before random draws or output files.

In the full simulator, `F_mean` is a multiplicative baseline per model step: `F_t = F_mean * exp(u_t)`. `F_sd` is the innovation SD of the AR(1) process `u_t` on the log-F scale; its stationary SD is `F_sd / sqrt(1 - F_ar^2)`. Thus `F_mean` is not the arithmetic mean of a realized F trajectory. The separate quick simulator uses `mean_F` for its realized arithmetic mean.
details.zh:
物种预设决定操作模型结构：flatfish 和 krill 使用 age_based，tuna 使用 length_based。检查返回的 model_type，再调用 sim_cal() 与 sim_data()。模拟结构标签与估计模型 acl、alscl 不同；模拟器与估计器的补充过程也不同。

从 2.2.4 起，快速年度模拟器的 `mean_F` 等于生成 F 序列的算术平均值；`mean_F = 0` 生成零捕捞死亡率。修正后的轨迹会改变重新生成的观测，即使使用旧种子也是如此。仓库已保存的数据和配图仍对应各自原始生成真值。

完整模拟器的 `nyear`、`burn_in` 都以年为单位，且分别必须对应整数个 `growth_step`。因此季度模式允许半年预热，年度模式不允许。返回的 `sm$nyear` 是保留时间步数；`first.year` 是第一期保留观测的年份，`sm$years` 保存完整观测时间轴。`simulation_to_tables()` 和 `sim_acl()` 保留这条时间轴；完全没有年份元数据的旧文件仍可使用从 2000 开始的后备规则。只保留一期时仍返回矩阵，但拟合至少需要两期。

`sim_acl()` 在发送 socket 任务前求值路径与参数变量，因此一般控制台或脚本中的变量传参也支持多核。保留失败重复并检查逐次拟合诊断；工作进程运行成功并不单独证明评估结果可用。

### 2.2.9 修订

模拟体长中点必须落在对应组内，检查规则与拟合一致；首尾组仍吸收分布尾部。参数准备阶段会拒绝无效分组，生物量计算和模拟前还会再次检查，包括用户手动修改的输入；错误发生在随机抽样和写文件前。

完整模拟器的 `F_mean` 是每模型时间步的乘法基准水平：`F_t = F_mean * exp(u_t)`。`F_sd` 是对数 F 的 AR(1) 过程 `u_t` 的创新标准差，平稳标准差为 `F_sd / sqrt(1 - F_ar^2)`；因此 `F_mean` 不是所生成 F 序列的算术平均值。另一个快速模拟器的 `mean_F` 才表示其生成序列的算术平均值。

description.en: Derive biological arrays and transition matrices from simulation parameters.
description.zh: 从模拟参数计算生物数组和转移矩阵。

value.en: A list of biological arrays: model_type identifies the operating-model structure; LatA is mean length at age; W_at_len is individual weight at length; mat is maturity; q_surv is survey catchability; sel is fishery selectivity; pla is the matrix of length probabilities conditional on age. Length coordinates and bounds are included. Gij is the one-step length-growth transition matrix for length_based models and NULL for age_based models.
value.zh: 生物数组列表：model_type 为生成模型结构；LatA 为平均年龄别体长；W_at_len 为体长别平均个体重量；mat 为成熟比例；q_surv 为调查可捕性；sel 为渔业选择性；pla 为给定年龄的体长概率矩阵。另含体长组坐标和边界；length_based 模型的 Gij 为体长组间一步生长转移矩阵，age_based 模型的 Gij 为 NULL。

details.en:
`pla` gives length-bin probabilities conditional on age. In the age_based simulator its rows are ages and columns are length bins (each row sums to one); in the length_based simulator its rows are length bins and columns are ages (each column sums to one). `Gij[i, j]` instead gives the probability of moving from source length bin j to destination bin i over one model step; each column sums to one. Call sim_cal() again after modifying biological parameters.

### Stable simulation boundaries in 2.2.5

`mat_func()` uses a stable logistic calculation: a steep increasing curve approaches one without overflowing. `L50` and `L95` must be distinct finite scalars; a descending curve (`L95 < L50`) remains available for dome selectivity. ### Matching fitted data in 2.2.5

`diagnostic_metrics()`, `diagnose_model()` and `compare_models()` check known time labels, length labels, the positive-observation mask and the observations stored with the fit. A table with reordered years or length bins is an error even when its dimensions match. Pass the original fitting table, for example `diagnose_model(x$data.CatL, b)`; these are in-sample diagnostics, not an interface for held-out prediction. Older results without metadata still support raw metrics, but cannot establish verified model comparability.

Comparison tables and metric plots share the same calculations: only finite positive observations contribute, R-squared is `NA` for constant observations, and nonfinite original-scale predictions at observed cells cause an error. Missing or zero observations remain excluded. Passing these checks does not establish model adequacy.

Fitting, diagnostics and comparison use the same interpretation of ordinary data frames, matrices, tibbles and numeric-text factor columns. Factor labels are converted to observation values, never to internal level codes. Length labels are extracted as a vector. The checks for changed observations, missing-data masks, time labels and length-bin order still apply.
details.zh:

description.en: Refit after progressively removing terminal observations and summarize retrospective patterns.
description.zh: 逐次删除末端观测并重新拟合，汇总回溯模式。

value.en: A list with results (peel trajectories), last_points (terminal estimates), rho_by_peel (relative differences by peel), rho_text (numerically screened Mohn's rho) and raw_rho_text (unscreened descriptive summaries). fit_diagnostics and errors retain fit status and errors. model_type, workers and nstarts record model and computation settings. With plot=TRUE, plot contains the plot object, or NULL when no finite estimates can be drawn.
value.zh: 列表包含 results（各次回溯轨迹）、last_points（各轨迹末点）、rho_by_peel（逐次回溯的相对差异）、rho_text（通过数值筛查后汇总的 Mohn's rho）和 raw_rho_text（未筛查的描述性汇总）。fit_diagnostics 与 errors 保留逐次拟合状态和错误；model_type、workers、nstarts 记录模型与计算设置。plot=TRUE 时另返回 plot 对象；无有效估计可绘制时 plot 为 NULL。

details.en:
`retro_acl()` and `retro_alscl()` choose the model for `retro_model()`. The function fits the full dataset and the peels internally. Supply matching data, fixed assumptions, maps and bounds. Each peel removes one model time step, not necessarily one calendar year. Positive and negative terminal differences can cancel in Mohn’s rho.

Version 2.2.3 accepts the same input bundle as the fitting functions: `retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` and `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`. The general form is `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`. Shared settings, then model-specific settings, then explicit call arguments determine each fit; explicit `map`, `parameters` and `control` replace their complete stored lists. `zero_action`, `control`, `nstarts`, `F_structure` and `polish` reach every fit. A fitting `ncores` stored in `x` is ignored: set `ncores` on the retrospective call for parallel peels. Within each peel, optimization starts run sequentially, with their number controlled by `nstarts`.

`fit_diagnostics` includes the full fit (`Peel = 0`) and every requested peel, with elapsed time, raw optimizer status, gradient, Hessian, boundaries and errors. `rho_by_peel` contains screened `Rho`, diagnostic `RawRho` and `Valid`. A quantity receives a reported value in `rho_text$Rho` only if the full fit and all requested peels pass the numerical screen and all terminal comparisons are finite with a nonzero reference. Otherwise it is `NA`, with a warning; failed peels are never silently dropped. `raw_rho_text` is an unscreened diagnostic summary, not a replacement for the screened result. It remains `NA` when a terminal comparison is missing. Available trajectories remain in `results` for inspection.

When all retrospective fits fail or no finite trajectories remain, `plot = TRUE` now warns and returns `plot = NULL` while preserving `fit_diagnostics`, `errors` and the unavailable rho values. Inspect those fields to correct the input or fitting problem. Requesting a plot must not prevent access to the failure record.

### Consistent package libraries in 2.2.5

Multistart fits, retrospective peels and simulation batches initialize socket workers with the parent session's library paths before loading ALSCL. This also applies when a newer installation is selected with `.libPaths()`. All workers must load the same ALSCL installation as the parent. Keep `nstarts` fixed when comparing worker counts; standard-error parallelism continues to use `alscl_speed()`.

The first and last model bins absorb the distribution tails. `len_border` contains only the internal boundaries; `len_mid` contains one increasing midpoint per bin. For ALSCL, omit `len_lower` and `len_upper` to derive these bounds, or supply `c(-Inf, len_border)` and `c(len_border, Inf)`. Explicit finite outer endpoints are rejected: they do not implement a truncated length distribution. Finite labels such as `0-20` remain accepted as labels under the existing tail-bin convention.

Retrospective peels shorten time-dependent `map$dev_log_R` and `map$dev_log_F` with the retained periods. Supply maps for the full dataset: recruitment uses one entry per period; F uses group-by-time column order (age groups for ACL, length groups for ALSCL, one group for `F_structure = "year"`). Factor ties and fixed NA entries are retained. Invalid full-data map lengths are rejected. Scalar maps and `dev_log_N0` do not change with a peel.
details.zh:
`retro_acl()`、`retro_alscl()` 为 `retro_model()` 选择模型。函数在内部拟合完整数据及各次删减数据。应提供匹配的数据、固定假设、映射和边界。每次删除一个模型时间步，不一定是一整年。Mohn rho 中正负终点差可能抵消。

2.2.3 可直接使用与拟合函数相同的输入：`retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` 和 `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`。通用写法为 `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`。各次拟合依次使用共用设置、模型专用设置及调用时显式覆盖值；显式 `map`、`parameters` 和 `control` 会整体替换对应列表。`zero_action`、`control`、`nstarts`、`F_structure` 和 `polish` 都传给每次拟合。`x` 内用于拟合的 `ncores` 不用于回溯：请在回溯调用中显式设置 `ncores`，控制同时运行的截短拟合数。每个截短拟合内部依序运行 `nstarts` 个起点。

`fit_diagnostics` 保存完整拟合（`Peel = 0`）和每个请求的截短拟合，包含耗时、原始优化状态、梯度、Hessian、边界与错误。`rho_by_peel` 包含筛查后的 `Rho`、诊断用的 `RawRho` 及 `Valid`。只有完整拟合和所有请求的截短拟合都通过数值筛查，且所有末端比较有限、参考值非零时，才在 `rho_text$Rho` 中报告该指标的 rho；否则返回 `NA` 并警告，不会悄悄删除失败的截短结果。`raw_rho_text` 是未经筛查的诊断汇总，不能替代正式报告值；若任一末端比较缺失，它仍为 `NA`。可用轨迹保留在 `results` 中供检查。

当全部回溯拟合失败或没有有限轨迹时，`plot = TRUE` 会警告并返回 `plot = NULL`，同时保留 `fit_diagnostics`、`errors` 及不可用的 rho。应根据这些字段修正输入或拟合设置。请求绘图不再阻止读取失败记录。

### 2.2.5 的并行安装库一致性

多起点拟合、回溯和模拟批次的 socket 进程先接收主会话的库路径，再加载 ALSCL；通过 `.libPaths()` 选择新安装版本时也适用。所有工作进程必须加载与主进程相同的 ALSCL 安装。比较核数时保持 `nstarts` 相同，标准误并行继续由 `alscl_speed()` 控制。

模型首尾体长组吸收分布尾部。`len_border` 只包含内部边界，`len_mid` 是每组递增的中心值。ALSCL 可以省略 `len_lower` 和 `len_upper`，由内部边界生成；若显式提供，必须分别为 `c(-Inf, len_border)` 和 `c(len_border, Inf)`。显式有限外端点会被拒绝，不会实现有限截断的体长分布。`0-20` 等有限区间标签仍可使用，但遵循原有首尾组吸收尾部的约定。

回溯子拟合会随保留时期同步截短 `map$dev_log_R` 与 `map$dev_log_F`。请提供完整数据长度的映射：补充量每期一项；F 按组别×时期矩阵的列顺序排列，ACL 使用年龄组、ALSCL 使用体长组，`F_structure = "year"` 只有一组。因子共享关系和固定的 NA 项会保留；完整映射长度错误会明确报错。标量映射及 `dev_log_N0` 不随回溯截短。

details.en:
`retro_acl()` and `retro_alscl()` choose the model for `retro_model()`. The function fits the full dataset and the peels internally. Supply matching data, fixed assumptions, maps and bounds. Each peel removes one model time step, not necessarily one calendar year. Positive and negative terminal differences can cancel in Mohn’s rho.

Version 2.2.3 accepts the same input bundle as the fitting functions: `retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` and `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`. The general form is `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`. Shared settings, then model-specific settings, then explicit call arguments determine each fit; explicit `map`, `parameters` and `control` replace their complete stored lists. `zero_action`, `control`, `nstarts`, `F_structure` and `polish` reach every fit. A fitting `ncores` stored in `x` is ignored: set `ncores` on the retrospective call for parallel peels. Within each peel, optimization starts run sequentially, with their number controlled by `nstarts`.

`fit_diagnostics` includes the full fit (`Peel = 0`) and every requested peel, with elapsed time, raw optimizer status, gradient, Hessian, boundaries and errors. `rho_by_peel` contains screened `Rho`, diagnostic `RawRho` and `Valid`. A quantity receives a reported value in `rho_text$Rho` only if the full fit and all requested peels pass the numerical screen and all terminal comparisons are finite with a nonzero reference. Otherwise it is `NA`, with a warning; failed peels are never silently dropped. `raw_rho_text` is an unscreened diagnostic summary, not a replacement for the screened result. It remains `NA` when a terminal comparison is missing. Available trajectories remain in `results` for inspection.

When all retrospective fits fail or no finite trajectories remain, `plot = TRUE` now warns and returns `plot = NULL` while preserving `fit_diagnostics`, `errors` and the unavailable rho values. Inspect those fields to correct the input or fitting problem. Requesting a plot must not prevent access to the failure record.

Multistart fits, retrospective peels and simulation batches initialize socket workers with the parent session's library paths before loading ALSCL. This also applies when a newer installation is selected with `.libPaths()`. All workers must load the same ALSCL installation as the parent. Retrospective peels shorten time-dependent `map$dev_log_R` and `map$dev_log_F` with the retained periods. Supply maps for the full dataset: recruitment uses one entry per period; F uses group-by-time column order (age groups for ACL, length groups for ALSCL, one group for `F_structure = "year"`). description.en: Plot log-scale survey residuals.
description.zh: 绘制调查指数的对数尺度残差。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
Both ACL and ALSCL fits are supported. `type="length"` uses time on the x-axis and one facet per length bin; `type="year"` uses length on the x-axis and one facet per model period, including quarterly periods. Residuals are observed log index minus fitted `Elog_index`. Missing and excluded observations are not evidence of a perfect fit. Inspect time and length structure as well as overall error size.

`plot_ridges()` and `plot_residuals()` use saved `observations` to preserve the same positive-observation mask as fitting; legacy fits can use their TMB data. NA and excluded zero cells are never converted to artificial observations or zero residuals. A wholly unobserved period has no observed ridge. With partial coverage, the observed ridge is normalized over observed positive cells, whereas predictions cover all bins: do not interpret this as agreement over unobserved bins. These plots work after removing `obj` from a fit that retains `observations`.

Both residual layouts honor per-call `title`, `xlab`, `ylab` and `title_hjust`. For example, `plot_residuals(b, type = "year", title = "Survey residuals", xlab = "Length (cm)", ylab = "Log residual", title_hjust = 0)` uses the supplied labels and a left-aligned title. Default plots remain free of major and minor gridlines.

Survey fit plots align both observed and predicted matrices by their positions and fitted calendar/length metadata, even if dimnames are added or removed. Missing and zero observations stay excluded. Use `exp_transform = FALSE` if exponentiating predictions would overflow. In residual plots, `resid_cap` must be a finite positive scalar or `NULL` to disable capping; negative or zero caps cannot erase the diagnostic pattern.

Each facet selects its smoother independently using the number of distinct valid x values: fewer than 2 omits the trend, 2–5 uses a linear fit, and 6 or more uses loess with its own span. A sparse group never changes another group's trend.
details.zh:
支持 ACL 和 ALSCL 拟合。`type="length"` 横轴为时间、按体长组分面；`type="year"` 横轴为体长、按模型时期分面，也适用于季度时期。残差为观测对数指数减去拟合 `Elog_index`。缺失或排除的观测不意味着完美拟合；除误差大小外还应检查时间与体长结构。

`plot_ridges()` 和 `plot_residuals()` 使用保存的 `observations`，保留与拟合一致的正观测掩码；旧结果可读取 TMB 数据。NA 和拟合时排除的零值不会变成人造观测或零残差。整期缺测不绘制观测山脊；部分缺测时，观测比例只在有效正观测中归一化，预测比例则覆盖全部体长组，不能把它解释为未观测组也拟合良好。保留 `observations` 的拟合结果移除 `obj` 后仍可使用这两个绘图函数。

残差图的两种布局均遵守单次调用的 `title`、`xlab`、`ylab` 和 `title_hjust`。例如 `plot_residuals(b, type = "year", title = "Survey residuals", xlab = "Length (cm)", ylab = "Log residual", title_hjust = 0)` 使用指定标签并左对齐标题。所有默认图继续不显示主、次网格线。

调查拟合图按矩阵位置及拟合年份、体长元数据对齐观测与预测，增删行列名不会改变坐标；缺失及零观测继续排除。若预测取指数会溢出，请使用 `exp_transform = FALSE`。残差图的 `resid_cap` 必须为有限正标量，或以 `NULL` 关闭截断；不再允许负值或零值抹去诊断特征。

每个分面按有效且不同的横坐标数量独立选择平滑方法：不足 2 个不画趋势，2–5 个使用线性拟合，6 个以上使用独立 span 的 loess。一个稀疏组不会改变其他组的趋势。

details.en:
Select recruitment (`R`) or fishing mortality (`F`) and inspect whether the chosen display exponentiates log deviations. This function plots process deviations, not an overall likelihood-deviance statistic.

`se = FALSE` uses reported deviations without a standard-error table; intervals require complete, finite, nonnegative standard errors.

In 2.2.9, omitted generic `line_size` and `se_alpha` inherit `acl_theme_set()` (defaults 1.5 and 0.2); explicit function arguments take priority. ACL F-deviation age panels use numeric order. `plot_pla(x_breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15))` selects age-bin ticks without removing heatmap cells.

`log = TRUE` labels log process deviations; `log = FALSE` labels multiplicative factors. Titles and y-axis labels use `dev_R`/`dev_F`, or `dev_R_multiplier`/`dev_F_multiplier` after exponentiation. These quantities are not likelihood deviances.

`se = FALSE` 使用报告中的过程偏差，无需标准误表；绘制区间则要求完整、有限、非负的标准误。

2.2.9 中，省略的通用 `line_size` 与 `se_alpha` 继承 `acl_theme_set()`（默认 1.5 与 0.2），函数显式参数优先。比较曲线遵守 `linetypes` 与 `compare_linetypes`，残差／指标组合图标题及 F 分面文字继承全局字体设置。默认仍无网格。ACL F 偏差图按年龄数字排序；`plot_pla(x_breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15))` 选择年龄组刻度，不删除热图单元。

`log = TRUE` 标明对数过程偏差；`log = FALSE` 标明乘数。标题和纵轴标签分别使用 `dev_R`/`dev_F`，指数转换后使用 `dev_R_multiplier`/`dev_F_multiplier`。这些量不是似然偏差统计量。

details.en:
The default viridis progression encodes time.

`plot_ridges()` and `plot_residuals()` use saved `observations` to preserve the same positive-observation mask as fitting; legacy fits can use their TMB data. NA and excluded zero cells are never converted to artificial observations or zero residuals. A wholly unobserved period has no observed ridge. With partial coverage, the observed ridge is normalized over observed positive cells, whereas predictions cover all bins: do not interpret this as agreement over unobserved bins. These plots work after removing `obj` from a fit that retains `observations`.

Saved fits containing observations and fitted reports support `plot_ridges()` without a live TMB object. Older fits without saved observations still require their original live object or refitting. Record version, commit, seed, provenance, units, maps, bounds, time step and diagnostics. An RDS file does not preserve a portable compiled model. The default `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` displays natural-log survey indices and labels that scale explicitly. `exp_transform = TRUE` displays original-scale survey indices; curves are fitted medians. An explicit `ylab` overrides the automatic label. Ridge compositions are normalized stably on the log scale, including very large or small finite log predictions; nonfinite predictions are rejected.

Panel titles identify observed and fitted survey length compositions, normalized separately within each period; they do not describe total catch.

`plot_ridges()` 和 `plot_residuals()` 使用保存的 `observations`，保留与拟合一致的正观测掩码；旧结果可读取 TMB 数据。NA 和拟合时排除的零值不会变成人造观测或零残差。整期缺测不绘制观测山脊；部分缺测时，观测比例只在有效正观测中归一化，预测比例则覆盖全部体长组，不能把它解释为未观测组也拟合良好。保留 `observations` 的拟合结果移除 `obj` 后仍可使用这两个绘图函数。

保存了观测与拟合报告的结果可直接使用 `plot_ridges()`，不需要活跃 TMB 对象。未保存观测的旧结果仍需原会话对象或重新拟合。记录包版本、提交号、随机种子、数据来源、三表单位、固定参数、边界、时间步和诊断；RDS 不保存可跨会话执行的编译模型。 默认 `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` 绘制自然对数调查指数，并在纵轴标明尺度；`exp_transform = TRUE` 绘制原尺度调查指数，预测曲线为中位数。显式 `ylab` 覆盖自动标签。山脊图在对数尺度稳定归一化，极大或极小的有限对数预测仍可绘制；非有限预测会报错。

description.en: Compare population time series from two fitted models.
description.zh: 比较两个拟合模型的种群时间序列。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.

details.en:
Use compatible observations, units and time steps. Optional intervals are conditional on each model’s fixed assumptions.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

Fishing-mortality plots use matrix positions and fitted time/group metadata, so matrix dimnames cannot alter the coordinates. Age panels in biomass, SSB, catch and F plots retain numeric group order with or without intervals. F plots and time-series comparisons require complete finite estimates and nonnegative finite standard errors when `se = TRUE`; missing summaries are errors rather than recycled values or silently removed intervals. Use `se = FALSE` explicitly for estimates only.

`plot_compare_ts()` defaults to the common SSB, recruitment, B, N and CN series. Explicit CB comparisons require CB in both models (ACL does not report it); CB uncertainty is not reported by either current model. Every requested quantity must be available; unknown or unavailable quantities produce an error. For fishing mortality use `plot_compare_annual_F(a, b, method = "apical")` or `method = "mean"`. These summarize F across groups per model period, not across periods; the mean is unweighted. This helper does not provide an uncertainty interval for the aggregate.

The metric bars now use the same calculation as `diagnostic_metrics()`: only finite positive observations contribute, so missing and zero observations do not turn every error metric into `NA`. Nonfinite predictions at observed cells and mismatched dimensions are errors. Undefined measures, such as R-squared for constant observations, remain `NA`. The figure is descriptive; use `compare_models()` to check comparability and numerical eligibility before interpreting differences.

### Matching fitted data in 2.2.5

`diagnostic_metrics()`, `diagnose_model()` and `compare_models()` check known time labels, length labels, the positive-observation mask and the observations stored with the fit. A table with reordered years or length bins is an error even when its dimensions match. Pass the original fitting table, for example `diagnose_model(x$data.CatL, b)`; these are in-sample diagnostics, not an interface for held-out prediction. Older results without metadata still support raw metrics, but cannot establish verified model comparability.

Comparison tables and metric plots share the same calculations: only finite positive observations contribute, R-squared is `NA` for constant observations, and nonfinite original-scale predictions at observed cells cause an error. Missing or zero observations remain excluded. Passing these checks does not establish model adequacy.

value.zh: 重置选项并打印提示后，不可见地返回 NULL。

details.en:
This changes global plot settings for future plots in the current R session. It does not refit models or alter their estimates.

### Grid-free defaults in 2.2.5

All package plotting functions omit major and minor panel gridlines by default, including comparison panels and retrospectives. Colours, confidence intervals and axes retain their existing settings. Recreate an old plot after upgrading to apply the new defaults. Using `b` from the worked fitting example, keep a particular figure free of gridlines:

```r
p <- plot_SSB(b, se = TRUE)
p + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
```
details.zh:
重置当前 R 会话中后续绘图使用的全局设置，不会重新拟合模型或更改估计值。

### 2.2.5 默认无网格线

所有包内绘图默认去掉主、次面板网格线，包括模型比较和回溯图；配色、置信区间及坐标轴保留原设置。升级后需重新创建旧图，才会应用新默认值。以下使用完整拟合示例中的 `b`，明确保持某张图无网格：

```r
p <- plot_SSB(b, se = TRUE)
p + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
```

description.en: Check complete data and model settings before compiling or fitting.
description.zh: 在编译或拟合之前检查完整数据和模型设置。

value.en: A list with valid, model, errors, warnings, summary, time and length_bins. Invalid inputs return valid = FALSE with an error message.
value.zh: 返回 valid、model、errors、warnings、summary、time 和 length_bins。输入不合法时 valid = FALSE，并给出错误原因。

details.en: Shares the actual fitting preparation for table alignment, time spacing, bins, biology, starts, bounds and maps. Does not compile TMB or optimize. Summary includes positive/zero/missing observations, entirely unobserved periods/bins and independent free fixed/random parameter counts. Warnings identify excluded zeros, unobserved blocks and positive observations no more numerous than free fixed parameters. These are input screens, not evidence of identifiability, convergence or biological adequacy.
details.zh: 与核心拟合共用三表、时间间隔、体长边界、生物学输入、初值、上下界和 map 的准备逻辑，不编译 TMB、不优化。摘要列出正值、零值、缺失值、完全无观测的时段／体长组，以及独立自由固定效应／随机效应数量。警告指出排除的零值、无观测区块，以及正观测数不超过自由固定效应数的情况。这些只是输入检查，不证明可辨识性、收敛或生物学适用性。

description.en: Inspect conditional observation residuals with a time–length heatmap, actual-time lag correlations and a normal QQ plot.
description.zh: 用时间–体长热图、按实际时间间隔计算的滞后相关及正态 QQ 图检查条件观测残差。

value.en: A list with residuals, lag_correlations (length, lag, elapsed_time, n_pairs, correlation, status), pooled qq_data, plots$heatmap, plots$lag, plots$qq, time_step and interpretation notes. Unavailable correlations are NA with an explicit status.
value.zh: 列表包含残差表 residuals、滞后相关表 lag_correlations（体长、滞后、实际时间差、有效配对数、相关系数与状态）、汇总 QQ 数据、三张图 plots$heatmap/lag/qq、time_step 和解释说明。无法计算的相关系数保留为 NA，并给出原因。

details.en: residuals(fit, type = "log") returns a long table of observed minus fitted log index; type = "standardized" divides by the fitted observation SD. It retains original observations, model times and length coordinates, marks excluded cells, and assigns NA residuals to zero/missing observations. check_fit() uses standardized residuals. Gaps are never compressed; correlations require at least three finite paired values at the requested actual lag and nonconstant values on both sides. These residuals condition on fitted latent effects: standardization is not a guarantee of independence, calibrated tests or model adequacy. Plots follow the package's grid-free theme.
details.zh: residuals(fit, type = "log") 返回观测对数值减去拟合对数值的长表；type = "standardized" 再除以拟合的观测标准差。表中保留原始观测、模型时间与体长坐标，标记被排除的单元，零值或缺失观测的残差为 NA。check_fit() 使用标准化残差。缺失时段不会压缩；相关系数要求在指定实际时间间隔上至少有三对有限观测，且两侧均非常数。这些残差以拟合的潜在效应为条件：标准化不代表残差独立、检验已校准或模型适合度已得到证明。绘图遵循包的无网格主题。

description.zh: 统一提取带坐标的种群估计
description.en: Extract population estimates with coordinates

value.zh: 含量名、实际报告名、年份、年龄、体长、估计、SE、区间及 numerical_ok 的长表。
value.en: A long table containing quantity, report name, time, age, length, estimate, SE, interval and numerical_ok.

details.zh:
估计来自 report，SE 只按完整、精确同名的 est_std 行提取。未报告 SE 时保留 NA，不造出区间。F 保留原分组和每模型步单位，不自动求平均或年化。FA 使用存活区间的起始年龄和时期；正态区间不截零。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。
details.en:
Estimates use report and complete exact-name SE rows from est_std. Missing uncertainty remains NA. F retains native groups and per-step units without averaging or annualization. FA uses source ages and periods. Normal intervals are not truncated at zero.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().

description.zh: 提取参数、尺度与固定状态
description.en: Extract parameters, scales and estimation status

value.zh: 参数表，包括估计、SE、区间、固定／估计／停用状态及数值检查标记。
value.en: A parameter table with estimates, SEs, intervals, fixed/estimated/inactive status and the numerical-screen flag.

details.zh:
有完整配方时包括固定参数；其 SE 和区间为 NA。旧对象仅能可靠列出自由固定效应。自然尺度 SE 用 delta method，区间转换内部尺度 Wald 端点；exp(mean_log_F) 和 exp(mean_log_R) 是过程基准水平，不是时间算术平均。检查 numerical_ok 后再解释不确定性。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。
details.en:
With a recipe, fixed parameters are included with NA uncertainty. Legacy objects expose only free fixed effects. Natural-scale SEs use the delta method; intervals transform internal Wald endpoints. exp(mean_log_F) and exp(mean_log_R) is a process baseline, not a time average. Inspect numerical_ok before interpreting uncertainty.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().

description.en: Fit named sensitivity scenarios on common observations with serial or socket execution.
description.zh: 在同一观测数据上串行或 socket 并行拟合具名敏感性情景。

value.en: A list with named fits/error records, resolved settings, status, elapsed, estimates, model, F_summary and workers.
value.zh: 返回具名拟合/错误记录、完整设置、状态、耗时、估计长表、模型、F 汇总方式和工作进程数。

details.en: Warnings and failed numerical screens remain visible, with no automatic ranking. The number of starts is preserved in serial and parallel modes. Fits omit session-specific obj pointers; refit_model() can rebuild a live objective. This interface does not implement checkpoint/resume.
details.zh: 保留警告和未通过数值筛查的结果，不自动排名。串行和并行保留相同初始点数量。结果移除会话专用 obj 指针，需要可执行目标函数时使用 refit_model()；本接口不实现断点续跑。

description.en: Inspect effective parameter starts, bounds and free/fixed/tied restrictions.
description.zh: 查看实际初值、上下界，以及自由、固定或共享的参数状态。

value.en: A data frame with parameter, kind, start, natural_start, lower, upper, transform, status, map_source, size, dimensions, n_free, n_fixed and n_tied.
value.zh: 包含 parameter、kind、start、natural_start、lower、upper、transform、status、map_source、size、dimensions、n_free、n_fixed、n_tied 的数据框。

details.en: Uses actual data-derived starts, clamped free starts, recruitment-age bounds, default maps and shared-F restrictions. kind=fixed_effect means an outer-model parameter, not necessarily a parameter fixed by map. Status can be free, fixed, tied, mixed or inactive. map_source distinguishes default, explicit, unmapped and F_structure. Random blocks start at zero; n_free counts independent mapped values and n_tied counts additional entries sharing them. exp(mean_log_R) and exp(mean_log_F) are baseline process levels on the natural scale, not arithmetic means; random natural_start is a multiplier. No compilation is performed.
details.zh: 使用真实的数据初值、按上下界截断的自由初值、补充年龄约束、默认 map 和共享 F 约束。kind=fixed_effect 指外层模型参数，并不表示该参数被 map 固定。status 可为 free、fixed、tied、mixed 或 inactive；map_source 区分 default、explicit、unmapped 和 F_structure。随机效应块初值为零，n_free 为独立映射值数量，n_tied 为共享这些值的额外元素数量。exp(mean_log_R) 和 exp(mean_log_F) 是自然尺度上的过程基准水平，不是算术平均值；随机效应的 natural_start 是乘数。全程无需编译。

description.en: Prepare a reusable input bundle from tables, three CSV files or an Excel workbook.
description.zh: 把三张数据表、三个 CSV 文件或 Excel 工作簿整理为可直接拟合的输入列表。

value.en: A structured list containing data.CatL, data.wgt, data.mat, fit_args and optional fit_config.
value.zh: 包含 data.CatL、data.wgt、data.mat、fit_args 以及可选 fit_config 的结构化列表。

details.en: This constructor converts numeric text safely and checks table values and alignment. It never fills or reorders missing periods and does not infer biology. Supply rec.age, nage, M, sel_L50 and sel_L95 in fit_args, then run check_alscl_data(x, model). Settings follow shared fit_args, selected fit_config, then explicit run arguments; list-valued settings replace the entire corresponding list. Named NULL map releases remain intact. Zeros remain zeros until the fitting zero_action excludes or rejects them.
details.zh: 安全转换数字文本，并检查三表的数值和排列是否一致；不填补或重排缺失时段，也不推测生物学参数。在 fit_args 中提供 rec.age、nage、M、sel_L50、sel_L95，再运行 check_alscl_data(x, model)。优先级为共享 fit_args、选中的 fit_config、显式运行参数；列表参数整体替换，具名 NULL 的 map 释放规则保留。零值在导入后仍为零，由拟合的 zero_action 决定排除或拒绝。

description.en: Fix a free scalar at each grid value and reoptimize the remaining parameters and random effects.
description.zh: 逐网格固定一个自由标量参数，重新优化其余参数及随机效应。

value.en: A list containing grid diagnostics, objectives and delta_nll, portable fits, resolved settings, reference objective and timing.
value.zh: 返回网格诊断、目标函数及 delta_nll、可移植拟合、完整设置、参照目标值和耗时。

details.en: Other free scalar starts come from the fitted optimum; fixed values and named NULL releases are preserved. At least one other free scalar must remain. delta_nll is relative to the original fit and can be negative, prompting rechecking of that optimum. Failed points remain visible. No automatic confidence intervals or chi-square cutoffs are provided. External assumptions use fit_scenarios().
details.zh: 其余自由标量初值取自拟合最优点，保留固定值和具名 NULL 释放。必须至少保留一个其他自由标量。delta_nll 相对于原拟合，可为负值并提示重查最优点。保留失败点，不自动生成置信区间或卡方阈值；外部假设使用 fit_scenarios()。

description.en: Project explicit deterministic population scenarios from the terminal fitted ACL or ALSCL state.
description.zh: 从 ACL 或 ALSCL 拟合末期状态开始，按明确给定的假设推演确定性种群情景。

value.en: summary contains year, N, B, SSB, Rec, CN, CB, F_mean and F_apical. trajectories and fishing_mortality are long tables. states contains NA, NL and ALSCL NLA; catch contains CNA and CNL. Supplied biology, F, time grid and assumptions are retained. CN is numbers; CB uses the supplied individual-weight units.
value.zh: summary 包含时间、总数量 N、生物量 B、SSB、补充量 Rec、捕捞数量 CN、捕捞生物量 CB、F_mean 和 F_apical；trajectories 和 fishing_mortality 为长表。states 保存 NA、NL 及 ALSCL 的 NLA；catch 保存 CNA 和 CNL。结果同时保留未来生物资料、F、时间轴及假设。CN 为数量，CB 的单位由个体体重单位决定。

details.en: Population states, B and SSB are at the start of each future period. The first future state survives the terminal fitted population through terminal fitted F and original M, then receives the first future recruitment. Future F[t]/M[t] determine catch[t] and survival into t+1, so a one-period F change affects catch but not start-of-period SSB. ACL advances ages and the plus group through its fitted age-length key; ALSCL applies length-specific survival before its fitted growth matrix. ACL catch biomass is derived by mapping catch-at-age through the fitted key. F_mean is an unweighted group mean and F_apical a group maximum; neither annualizes quarterly rates. These are deterministic conditional scenarios with fixed growth, explicit recruitment and future biology, no uncertainty intervals, no estimated stock-recruitment relationship and no automatic MSY/TAC calculation.
details.zh: 种群状态、B 和 SSB 对应每个未来时段开始时。第一期未来状态先让拟合末期种群经历末期拟合 F 和原始 M 的死亡，再加入第一期未来补充量。未来 F[t]/M[t] 决定该期捕捞以及进入 t+1 的存活，因此仅改变一期 F 会改变当期捕捞，而不会改变期初 SSB。ACL 推进年龄组和末龄加组，并使用拟合的年龄–体长键；ALSCL 先按体长存活，再通过拟合的生长矩阵。ACL 的捕捞生物量由年龄捕捞量经该键转换得到。F_mean 是组间未加权平均值，F_apical 是组间最大值，均不把季度死亡率换算成年率。这是固定生长、明确补充量与未来生物资料的确定性条件情景，没有不确定性区间、没有估计的亲体量–补充量关系，也不自动计算 MSY/TAC。

description.zh: 读取可移植评估存档
description.en: Read a portable assessment archive

value.zh: 带完整配方和估计结果的 alscl_fit 对象；没有活跃 obj。
value.en: An alscl_fit with its complete recipe and estimates, without a live obj.

details.zh: 校验存档格式和 schema。读取后可使用 summary、提取函数和基于报告的绘图；需要活跃模型时重新拟合。
details.en: Validates the archive format and schema. Summaries, extractors and report-based plots work after reading; refit to obtain a live model.

description.en: Read aligned survey, weight and maturity tables from three CSV files.
description.zh: 从三个 CSV 文件读取对齐的调查、体重和成熟比例数据表。

value.en: A named list containing the three numeric data tables, ready for prepare_alscl_data().
value.zh: 包含三张数值数据表的具名列表，可交给 prepare_alscl_data()。

details.en: The first column contains length-bin labels and subsequent headers contain numeric time labels. Blank cells and NA represent missing values. Numeric text is converted without using factor level codes. Rows and columns retain their original order. Weight and maturity tables must be complete; survey zeros and missing values remain explicit. Biological inputs are not inferred.
details.zh: 第一列为体长组标签，后续表头为数值时间标签。空白单元格和 NA 表示缺失；数字文本按显示值转换，不使用因子内部编码。保留原始行列顺序。体重和成熟比例必须完整，调查数据的零值和缺失值保留，不推测生物学输入。

description.en: Read survey, weight and maturity sheets from an Excel workbook.
description.zh: 读取 Excel 工作簿中的调查、体重和成熟比例工作表。

value.en: A named list containing the three numeric data tables.
value.zh: 包含三张数值数据表的具名列表。

details.en: Requires the optional readxl package. Sheet names must match exactly. The first column is the length-bin label; remaining headers are numeric time labels. The reader applies the same value and alignment checks as read_survey_csv(), preserves zero and missing survey cells, and does not infer biology or fill missing periods.
details.zh: 需要可选的 readxl 包。工作表名称必须完全一致。第一列为体长组标签，后续表头为数值时间标签。使用与 read_survey_csv() 相同的数值和对齐检查；保留调查零值和缺失值，不推测生物学输入或填补时段。

description.zh: 按保存配方重新拟合
description.en: Refit a stored assessment recipe

value.zh: 新的拟合结果、更新后的配方和当前会话活跃 TMB 对象。
value.en: A fresh fit with an updated recipe and live TMB object.

details.zh: 默认复用原始初值、完整输入与记录的 AD／标准误设置；完成后恢复调用者速度选项。除非显式 output=TRUE，否则不写绘图文件。更换软件版本不保证逐位一致。
details.en: Reuses original starts, complete inputs and recorded AD/SE settings, restoring caller options afterward. File output is disabled unless output=TRUE is explicit. Bitwise identity across software versions is not guaranteed.

description.zh: 保存完整可移植评估
description.en: Save a portable assessment

value.zh: 不可见地返回文件路径；不修改原拟合。
value.en: Invisibly returns the file path without changing the original fit.

details.zh: 存档剔除会话专属 obj 指针，保存配方、输入、map、边界、设置、版本和报告。失败时保留原存档。配方不等于可跨会话执行的 TMB 指针；重建需要 refit_model()。
details.en: The archive omits the session-specific obj pointer and retains inputs, maps, bounds, settings, versions and reports. Failed replacement preserves the old archive. Use refit_model() to rebuild a live TMB model.

description.en: Convenience interface for simulation batches fitted with ALSCL.
description.zh: 使用 ALSCL 拟合模拟批次的便捷入口。

value.en: A named list of replicate fits or error records, including iter and elapsed. Every result also replaces its `result_rep_<id>` file.
value.zh: 返回包含 iter 和 elapsed 的具名拟合或错误记录列表；每个结果同时替换对应 `result_rep_<id>` 文件。

details.en: Recorded time and length coordinates are retained. Each replicate uses one inner fitting worker and sequential standard errors. Failed reruns replace old success files. M and F are per model step. This fits operating-model simulations; it does not automatically create a fitted parametric bootstrap.
details.zh: 保留模拟文件中的时间和体长坐标。每次拟合内部使用一个进程及顺序标准误。失败重跑会替换旧成功文件。M、F 均为每模型时间步单位。这是操作模型模拟数据拟合，不自动构成拟合模型参数自助法。

description.en: Fit ACL or ALSCL to saved simulation replicates using the same batch pipeline.
description.zh: 使用统一批次流程，把 ACL 或 ALSCL 拟合到已保存的模拟重复数据。

value.en: A named list of replicate fits or error records, including iter and elapsed. Every result also replaces its `result_rep_<id>` file.
value.zh: 返回包含 iter 和 elapsed 的具名拟合或错误记录列表；每个结果同时替换对应 `result_rep_<id>` 文件。

details.en: Recorded time and length coordinates are retained. Each replicate uses one inner fitting worker and sequential standard errors. Failed reruns replace old success files. M and F are per model step. This fits operating-model simulations; it does not automatically create a fitted parametric bootstrap.
details.zh: 保留模拟文件中的时间和体长坐标。每次拟合内部使用一个进程及顺序标准误。失败重跑会替换旧成功文件。M、F 均为每模型时间步单位。这是操作模型模拟数据拟合，不自动构成拟合模型参数自助法。

description.en: Summarize simulation bias, RMSE, interval coverage, fitting failures and timing with explicit denominators.
description.zh: 使用明确分母汇总模拟偏差、RMSE、区间覆盖率、拟合失败与耗时。

value.en: A list with summary pooled over replicates/time by quantity, per-replicate status/timing and all pointwise estimates/truth, including failures.
value.zh: 返回按量跨重复/时间合并的 summary、逐重复状态/耗时，以及保留失败点的逐点估计和真值。

details.en:
Bias/RMSE use numerically valid estimate pairs; coverage additionally requires finite reported SEs. Attempted/valid replicate, point and interval counts and failure_rate are reported. Missing SEs are not counted as failed coverage. Relative bias excludes zero truth. F is excluded because its aggregation and uncertainty must be explicitly defined. These conditional performance summaries are not proof of general model superiority.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().
details.zh:
偏差和 RMSE 使用数值有效估计对，覆盖率额外要求有限的报告标准误。报告尝试/有效重复、点及区间数和 failure_rate。缺失标准误不算覆盖失败。相对偏差排除真值为零的点。F 因需要明确定义聚合和不确定性而排除。这些条件性能统计不证明模型普遍更优。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。
